enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Body relaxed. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, laying out work clothes and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Lay clothes on bed. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Place charger in bag. Place wallet in bag. Zip bag. Check appearance in mirror.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1, using toaster and kettle, drinking tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Say 'Good morning' to Member 1. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Add milk to tea. Open bread bag. Take out bread slices. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Remove toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Talk with Member 1 about work schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Final check and packing bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open bag. Check laptop. Check charger. Check notebook. Check pen. Check wallet. Check keys. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk to door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the arts organization office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Check messages. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as an arts administrator: answering emails, scheduling programs and planning exhibitions
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Open project management software. Create task for exhibition. Research potential venues. Contact artists via email. Draft exhibition proposal. Make phone calls to partners. Attend brief team meeting. Update project timeline. Print documents. File documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Leave office. Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order sandwich. Pay for sandwich. Receive sandwich. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Check phone. Throw away trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as an arts administrator: staff meetings, budget review and coordinating arts programming
enriched_activities.desc: Attend staff meeting. Take notes. Discuss budget. Open budget spreadsheet. Review expenses. Adjust budget items. Coordinate arts programming: call venue. Send email to artists. Update schedule. Meet with team. Review program materials. Edit documents. Print materials. Distribute materials. Attend follow-up meeting. Update project plan.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Say 'Hello' to Member 1. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Place ingredients on counter. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Simmer. Turn off stove. Set table. Serve food. Sit with Member 1. Eat dinner. Talk about day.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Wash plates. Wash utensils. Rinse dishes. Place in drying rack. Wipe counter with sponge. Dry counter with cloth. Put away leftovers in refrigerator. Wipe stove. Take out trash. Tie trash bag. Carry trash to bin.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room with the vacuum cleaner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug cord into outlet. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Vacuum rug. Turn off vacuum. Unplug cord. Wrap cord. Put vacuum away. Fluff pillows. Fold blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work at the desk using the computer, monitor and desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open illustration software. Create new canvas. Sketch outline. Use monitor for reference. Draw shapes. Add colors. Adjust layers. Use stylus to draw. Save file. Export image. Send client email. Continue drawing. Adjust desk lamp angle. Save file again. Close software. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and checking phone before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Open social media. Scroll feed. Read news. Set alarm. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Body relaxed. Remain asleep.
